stops.note: the poet Nikolai Glazkov typed his poems in the 1940s as 'Samsebyaizdat', Myself-by-Myself Publishers, mocking official names like Gospolitizdat; shortened to samizdat, it named hand-copied banned texts
known in the West as works like Solzhenitsyn's circulated in typescript; A Chronicle of Current Events, the dissident bulletin begun in 1968, was produced this way

current_meaning: the secret copying and distribution of banned literature, especially in the USSR
